title: Gemma 3 Model error
body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

client db (lobe-chat image)

### 📌 Version

latest

### 💻 Operating System

macOS, Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

Gemma 3 always errors with
```
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Developer instruction is not enabled for models/gemma-3-27b-it",
    "statusCode": 400,
    "statusCodeText": "[400 Bad Request]"
  },
  "provider": "google"
}
```

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. initiate a session with Google Gemma 3 Model
2. observe the above error

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

chat continues without error

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
